question: Does NPC reporting of a Lumot Lake event at Barangay Bukal, Cavinti support a municipality-coded research locality for the existing Lumot Reservoir lead?
method: Compared the historical BMB inventory row naming Lumot Reservoir, whose locality field is blank, with the existing scope lead alias Lumot Lake. NPC CLWAT reporting places a 12 December 2024 community clean-up event at Lumot Lake, Barangay Bukal, Cavinti, Laguna. PSA identifies Cavinti as municipality code 0403407000. Link only the NPC-described event locality through the already-recorded Lumot Lake alias; do not infer reservoir extent, a perimeter, or exclusive municipal containment.
sourceRows: BMB 2019: Lumot Reservoir | Laguna | locality blank | Water Storage | 637.36 ha.
NPC 2024: community clean-up event at Lumot Lake, Barangay Bukal, Cavinti, Laguna; 12 December 2024.

evidence.locator: Page 4, row Lumot Reservoir; locality cell blank.
Opening paragraph; event locality and date.

assignments.sourceRow: Lumot Lake | Barangay Bukal | Cavinti, Laguna | 12 December 2024 community clean-up event
assignments.sourceLocality: NPC-described community-event locality at Lumot Lake, Barangay Bukal, Cavinti, Laguna
assignments.limit: This links a reported community-event locality to the existing research alias. It is not a surveyed lake/reservoir boundary, does not establish exclusive containment within Cavinti, and supports no geometry, access, species, safety, regulation, or public-app assertion.

limitations: The NPC article reports a clean-up event locality, not a surveyed limnological or cadastral perimeter.
The BMB 2019 row classifies Lumot Reservoir as Water Storage and leaves its locality field blank; its reported area is not adopted.
The match uses the existing Lumot Lake scope alias as a working crosswalk, not a formal name determination.
PSGC confirms administrative names and codes only; no barangay or municipal polygon is imported.
No species assertions, geometry, access/safety/rules claims, or public records were added; scope remains unfrozen.
decision: Link the NPC-described Lumot Lake community-event locality at Barangay Bukal to Cavinti PSGC code 0403407000 through the existing Lumot Lake research alias; retain reservoir identity/extent and exclusive municipal containment as unresolved.
